data.title: Thailand's Muslim separatists vow to fight to the end
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Two decades into an insurgency that has killed thousands in southern Thailand, a leader of the main Malay-Muslim separatist group vowed this week to keep fighting until they achieve their goals.

data.title: Afghan medical students in Pakistan hope court stops college expulsions
data.description: KARACHI - Dozens of Afghans studying to be doctors in Pakistan hope a court hearing on Friday will overturn an order by the country's medical board for them to be expelled from colleges and universities and sent home.

data.title: Illicit contact lenses, cosmetics worth B4.7m seized at warehouse
data.description: Police and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) officials have seized more than 132,000 unregistered contact lenses, cosmetics and vitamins worth 4.7 million baht from a warehouse in Samut Prakan allegedly operated by a Chinese national.

data.title: Doom Loop? Ed Sheeran struggles against Gaza tide
data.description: PARIS - Facing boycott calls and desertions, British singer Ed Sheeran has been left with a career crisis that underlines how even the world's biggest stars are being sucked into the politics of the war in Gaza.

data.title: Australian athlete who soiled herself apologises for continuing Hyrox race

data.description: LONDON - Michael Carrick needs a win at Fulham to ease the mounting pressure on troubled Manchester United while Tottenham are desperate for their first Premier League goal of the season against fellow strugglers Aston Villa.

data.title: Tokyo considers ordinance banning littering as downtown trash worsens
data.description: The Tokyo metropolitan government is considering an ordinance banning littering, as trash left in downtown entertainment districts has increased with the rise in tourists following the Covid-19 pandemic, government sources said on Thursday.

data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - As wars rage in the Middle East, Ukraine and Sudan, and fears mount over rapidly advancing AI, world leaders convened at the UN in New York for the world's signature diplomatic event.

data.title: Electrical worker dies after falling into Sukhumvit drain
data.description: A 32-year-old electrical contractor worker has died after apparently slipping and falling into a drainage pipe beneath Punnawithi BTS skytrain station in Bangkok’s Phra Khanong district on Friday morning.

data.title: Makro and Heliconia bring “Udon Love Like a PRO” to Udon Thani
data.description: Udon Thani – September 17, 2569 (2026): Makro, the leading wholesale business under CP Axtra Public Company Limited, has joined with leading business partner Heliconia H Group Company Limited and local entrepreneurs to launch the "Makro x Heliconia Udon Love Like a PRO" event, celebrating Makro's 37th anniversary. The four-day food, shopping and music festival at Muang Thong Charoensri Market features a landmark 30 meter waterfall, about the height of a 10-storey building, along with more than 50 celebrity chefs, popular restaurant menus, exceptional shopping deals and concerts by leading artists. Designed to boost the local economy and bring joy to the people of Udon Thani and visiting tourists, the event was honoured by Mr. Nattapong Khamwongpin, Deputy Governor of Udon Thani Province, who presided over the opening ceremony. Mr. Tanit Chearavanont, Group CEO Wholesale Business of CP AXTRA, Mr. Kitikorn Penrote, Chief Executive Officer of Heliconia H Group, and business partners welcomed guests.

data.title: Prized Mexican relic returns on loan, two centuries on
data.description: MEXICO CITY - A cherished 16th-century Mexican manuscript that tells the history of the Aztecs in pictograms went on display Thursday in Mexico City, nearly two centuries after it was whisked off to France.

data.title: US approves sale of 48 F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The United States has approved a $24.3 billion sale of 48 F-35 stealth warplanes to Saudi Arabia, the State Department said Thursday, the kingdom's latest major arms purchase since the start of the Iran war.
